ui.title: Gift Suggestion
birthday.banner: Today is {{npcName}}'s birthday! Gift friendship x8!
festival.banner: It's a festival today! Don't forget to gift!
gmcm.autoGift.name: Auto Gift
gmcm.autoGift.tooltip: When enabled, automatically gifts the best item from your backpack after dialogue without showing the menu. It never takes items from storage.
gmcm.showStorageItems.name: Show Storage Items
gmcm.showStorageItems.tooltip: When enabled, the manual gift suggestion menu includes supported storage devices. This may affect game balance.
